notes: Key changes vs K5: tower P+6+S with a 8.90 m Sejmik storey (extra office floor in the same envelope instead of a 12 m void); hall turned — presidium at the solid south wall, councillors' backs to the Odra/cathedral panorama, citizens on the gallery see their Sejmik against the city.

Sejmik level (right) balances: rooms 875 m² + cores 119 m² + 2.25 × 39 m lobby corridor linking both stair cores, hall, 2 committee and 4 club rooms; mezzanine only an open public gallery reached by 2 public lifts from the Citizens' Entrance on the boulevard.

Façades: vertical order on the Mazowiecka frontage (window axis 2.025 m ≈ tenement rhythm, 1.20 × 2.40 windows, 4 'plots' in 4 ceramic tones), granite piers 2.70 m on the tower, horizontal ceramic bands only on the R-14 m corner; crown glazing cut by 60 % (262 m²) behind vertical ceramic lamellas.
Bridge Gate: 3 m arcade along the whole arc and 12.5 m of the north façade; straight diagonal axis (33 m) through the Citizens' Hall from the bridge to the public garden keeping all 29 garden trees.

Numbers: 187 offices, 6/6 meeting rooms and 20/20 stores on façades, 109 parking (55 EV), PV 412 kWp as roofing only, retention 151 m³ (zero runoff), GWP target ≤ 500 kgCO₂e/m²; §13 margins: segment 1.05 m (worst case), tower 1.49 m.
